meta.principle: Precision over recall. A URL is VERIFIED only if a content check confirms it is (1) a real medical-necessity policy/criteria document (not a search page, code list, benefit grid, or login wall), (2) contains actual criteria for the SPECIFIC procedure (indications + conservative care/PT/imaging), (3) is current (not superseded), and (4) is public. Anything else is not trusted.
meta.medicare_jurisdiction_notes: No national NCD sets medical-necessity criteria for any of the 11 surgical procedures; coverage is via per-MAC LCDs + Billing/Coding Articles that vary by state. TKA (27447) & THA (27130): no NCD; local 'Total Knee/Hip' or 'Total Joint Arthroplasty' LCDs, e.g. Noridian L36577/L36573 (both RETIRED 2025-11-06) and Palmetto Total Joint Arthroplasty L39911/legacy L36039. Total shoulder (23472): no NCD; per-MAC LCDs e.g. Palmetto L39956 (active). Lumbar fusion (22612): no NCD; per-MAC LCDs e.g. Palmetto Lumbar Spinal Fusion L37848 (+articles A56396/A56397) and Novitas/FCSO L33382. Cervical fusion/ACDF (22551): no NCD; per-MAC LCDs e.g. Novitas Cervical Fusion L39793 (this ver superseded). Lumbar microdiscectomy/decompression (63030): no NCD; addressed within some fusion/decompression LCDs, otherwise MAC discretion. Rotator cuff repair (29827), ACL reconstruction (29888), total ankle arthroplasty (27702), bunionectomy/hallux valgus (28296), hip arthroscopy (29914-29916): no national NCD and generally no dedicated national LCD; coverage determined case-by-case by the local MAC. Musculoskeletal MRI (73721/73221/72148): a national NCD DOES exist - MRI NCD 220.2 (ncdid=177, active) - but it is general; MSK-MRI specifics are left to local MAC LCDs/articles. Key MACs across the listed payers' footprints: Noridian (JE/JF - West), Palmetto GBA (JJ/JM - Southeast), Novitas (JH/JL - South/Mid-Atlantic), WPS, NGS, CGS, First Coast (JN - FL). Every stand-in URL must be mapped to the beneficiary's state MAC LCD.

verdict_notes.no_procedure_specific_criteria: The document is real, official, current and public, and it does govern authorization for this payer -- but it sets out a utilization-review PROCESS, not indication-level medical-necessity criteria for the specific procedure. Useful for citing the payer's own review obligations in an appeal; not usable for quoting 'here is the criterion I meet'.

https://comagine.org/sites/default/files.doc_type: State Medicaid utilization-review provider manual (Comagine Health, Alaska DHSS UR contractor)
https://comagine.org/sites/default/files.note: This is the manual governing Alaska Medicaid pre-service (prior authorization), concurrent and retrospective review of inpatient surgical admissions. It is the right document for how Alaska Medicaid must review a request, but it publishes NO procedure-specific orthopedic medical-necessity criteria. Alaska Medicaid is fee-for-service; the state service-authorization page points to this UR process. An appeal here should demand the specific criteria applied to the denial rather than quote this manual as if it contained them.
